description.value: Istanbul Döner Shop is a Turkish street-food spot on Denman Street in Vancouver's West End, a neighbourhood popular with cyclists riding the seawall route to and from Stanley Park. The menu centres on kofte platters and wraps served with freshly baked tombik bread and rice, ordered online through a Square storefront. Its location on one of Vancouver's busiest cycling corridors makes it a convenient quick stop for touring riders.
